events.title: Climate assessment staff fired, congressional mandate unclear
events.summary: The Trump administration fired personnel preparing a congressionally mandated climate assessment. It remains unclear whether the administration plans to hire replacement staff to fulfill the statutory requirement or simply abandon the mandate.
events.why_relevant: Termination of staff preparing a congressionally mandated assessment signals potential non-compliance with legislative requirements and undermines climate science integration into federal policy.
events.basis: Trump did fire the people preparing a congressionally mandated climate assessment; it's not clear whether he plans to hire other people to do it, or to simply ignore the mandate.
